Name: Community Center Companion
Author: Schenifu
Description:
Community Center Companion helps you keep track of the Community Center requirements throughout Year .

The mod adds detailed Community Center information to item tooltips, including which bundles an item is needed for and how many are required.

When you are carrying an item that is still needed for the Community Center, the corresponding bundle is highlighted directly in the Community Center menu with a clear marker.

Completed requirements are automatically removed from the planner, so the markers stay focused on what you still need.

The goal is simple: help you avoid accidentally selling, using, or forgetting items that you still need for the Community Center.

Downloads.Description: Community Center Companion 0.2.0 adds English and German localization with automatic language detection, improved Community Center tooltips, and improved stability and structure.
